corrections: Initial600Nm torque could not overcome stable inverted buoyancy. Final2400Nm cap is explicitly a bounded cooperative gameplay assist,not inferred human-force realism.
First browser timeout was a fixture race:input was sent before every peer received its unpause snapshot. Final fixture waits for all4 peers and observed3-helper state;original timeout preserved.

Submerged overturned hull is difficult to locate in Low water. A simple surface rescue ring follows its actual horizontal position and shared water height only during rescue;full swimmer/rope animation remains open.

Native eddy regression found asynchronous snapshot/save message ordering could replace encounter guidance with redundant Checkpoint saved. Remove only the duplicate save-ack toast,retain actual persistence/error reporting,and pass original instruction plus600ms late-ack check.

Explicit server neutral rearming now rejects in-flight held actions after capsize entry or success;both transitions clear row controllers and require neutral before powering movement. Real sockets cover both guards.
limits: Righting torque is gameplay assist,not a swimmer/rope or naval capsize model. Hull/crew can remain submerged until righted;surface ring marks the actual location.
15-second fallback uses simulation time and pauses with the existing shared disconnect barrier.
Production swimmer/crew animation,sound/human readability/fairness,full-route human pacing,regional art and Internet/device/long-browser acceptance remain open.
